name: player.nvim
description: A Neovim music player written entirely in TypeScript: mpv playback, LRCLIB/JioSaavn/lrc.red lyrics, karaoke and translation.

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:lua
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:node && npm run test:lua
scripts.check:generated: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- lua plugin dist
